proof:
Source: step 3 (B2′) of the supplied proof, isolated for one piece (G, A) of the carrier of an IMRep. Conventions: Euclid P = ℝ^P; Hⁿ := μHE[n] (Euclidean-normalized Hausdorff measure); λ := volume on ℝⁿ = Euclid n (λ = μHE[n] there); e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1 (a ∈ Fin n); for a map K, DK(u) := fderiv ℝ K u (the zero map where K is not differentiable) and v_K(u) := (DK(u)e_a)_a; J_K(u) := √det(⟨DK(u)e_a, DK(u)e_b⟩)_{a,b} (Real.sqrt of the Gram determinant); |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; for v : Fin n → ℝ^P, ev_v ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) is α ↦ α(v) (ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ v); an IMRep R has carrier M, multiplicity θ := R.mult and orientation ξ := R.orient. Write V(u) := range DG(u), v(u) := v_G(u), J := J_G.
1. (Preliminaries.) G is continuous and injective on A (if G(a) = G(a') then m|a − a'| ≤ 0), so Y := G(A) is Borel (MeasurableSet.image_of_continuousOn_injOn). Y ⊆ M ⊆ U (R.carrier_subset). M is Borel (R.measurableSet_carrier) and locally Hⁿ-finite: for compact K ⊆ U, θ ≥ 1 on M (R.mult_pos, ℕ-valued), so Hⁿ(M ∩ K) ≤ ∫⁻_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ (R.locallyIntegrable_mult).
2. (Null-set transfer.) By the sibling bilip_measure, ofReal(m)ⁿλ(Z) ≤ Hⁿ(G(Z)) for every Z ⊆ A. (a) If p holds Hⁿ-a.e. on Y (∀ᵐ y ∂Hⁿ⌞Y, p y), then p(G u) holds for λ-a.e. u ∈ A: choose a Borel T ⊇ {y : ¬p y} with (Hⁿ⌞Y)(T) = Hⁿ(T ∩ Y) = 0; Z := A ∩ G⁻¹(T) contains every u ∈ A with ¬p(G u), and G(Z) ⊆ T ∩ Y, so ofReal(m)ⁿλ(Z) = 0 and λ(Z) = 0; since A is Borel, (λ⌞A){u : ¬p(G u)} = λ({u : ¬p(G u)} ∩ A) ≤ λ(Z) = 0. (b) G is quasi-measure-preserving from λ⌞A to Hⁿ⌞M: G is continuous, hence measurable, and for Borel B with Hⁿ(B ∩ M) = 0, (λ⌞A)(G⁻¹B) = λ(A ∩ G⁻¹B) ≤ ofReal(m)⁻ⁿHⁿ(G(A ∩ G⁻¹B)) ≤ ofReal(m)⁻ⁿHⁿ(B ∩ M) = 0, because G(A) ⊆ M.
3. (Tangent planes of the piece.) By the sibling piece_tangent (F := G, B := A, L, m): for λ-a.e. u ∈ A, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n Y (G u) V(u).
4. (Locality, (IMC)(a).) Apply (IMC)(a) with U, M := Y, M' := M (both Borel, Y ⊆ M ⊆ U, local finiteness by step 1): for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ Y and every Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n Y x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q. By step 2(a) this holds at x = G(u) for λ-a.e. u ∈ A.
5. (Orientation of M.) By R.orients, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M there is Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q. Since Y ⊆ M this holds Hⁿ-a.e. on Y (ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset), hence by step 2(a) at x = G(u) for λ-a.e. u ∈ A.
6. (The plane is V(u).) Fix u ∈ A outside the null sets of steps 3, 4, 5. By 3 and 4 (with Q := V(u)) M has approximate tangent space V(u) at G(u). Step 5 gives Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M (G u) Q and ξ(G u) a unit orientation of Q. By uniqueness of approximate tangent spaces (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique), Q = V(u); so ξ(G u) is a unit orientation of V(u).
7. (Frame identity, supplied (0b).) DG(u) is injective, so v(u) is linearly independent (the image of the standard basis EuclideanSpace.basisFun under an injective linear map, LinearIndependent.map') and span(range v(u)) = V(u) (the e_a span ℝⁿ). By the sibling wedge_orientation, det Gram(v(u)) > 0, so J(u) > 0, and ζ_u := J(u)⁻¹·ev_{v(u)} (ζ_u(α) = J(u)⁻¹α(v(u))) is a unit orientation of V(u). By the sibling orientation_sign, ξ(G u) = ζ_u or ξ(G u) = −ζ_u. Hence J(u)·ξ(G u) = ev_{v(u)} or J(u)·ξ(G u) = −ev_{v(u)}. This holds for λ-a.e. u ∈ A.
8. (Measurable choice of the sign.) Put f(u) := J(u)•ξ(G u) and e(u) := ev_{v(u)} (maps ℝⁿ → MultiVector P n; no finite-dimensionality of MultiVector P n is used). J is Borel (sibling area_lintegral, part (i)). u ↦ v(u) ∈ (Fin n → ℝ^P) is Borel (measurable_fderiv, evaluation at the fixed vectors e_a). The map v ↦ ev_v is continuous for the operator norm: ev is multilinear in v and |α(v) − α(w)| ≤ ‖α‖·Σ_a|v_a − w_a|·∏_{b≠a}max(|v_b|, |w_b|) (telescoping), so ‖ev_v − ev_w‖ → 0 as w → v; hence e is strongly measurable (Continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable). u ↦ ξ(G u) is a.e. strongly measurable for λ⌞A, because ξ is a.e. strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞M (R.aestronglyMeasurable_orient) and G is quasi-measure-preserving (step 2(b); AEStronglyMeasurable.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving). So f is a.e. strongly measurable for λ⌞A, and {u : f(u) = e(u)} is λ⌞A-null-measurable (nullMeasurableSet_eq_fun; MultiVector P n is a normed, hence metrizable, space). Let s₀(u) := 1 if f(u) = e(u) and s₀(u) := −1 otherwise; s₀ is a.e. measurable for λ⌞A. Let s₁ be measurable with s₁ = s₀ λ⌞A-a.e. (AEMeasurable.mk) and put s(u) := 1 if s₁(u) = 1, s(u) := −1 otherwise. Then s is measurable, s(u) ∈ {1, −1} for every u, and s = s₀ λ⌞A-a.e.
9. (Conclusion.) For λ-a.e. u ∈ A, step 7 holds and s(u) = s₀(u). If f(u) = e(u), then s(u) = 1 and J(u)ξ(G u)(α) = α(v(u)) = s(u)α(v(u)) for all α. Otherwise f(u) ≠ e(u), so by step 7 f(u) = −e(u), s(u) = −1 and J(u)ξ(G u)(α) = −α(v(u)) = s(u)α(v(u)). ∎
key_steps: G(A) is a Borel subset of the locally Hⁿ-finite carrier M; bilip_measure transfers Hⁿ-a.e. statements on G(A) to λ-a.e. statements on A and makes G quasi-measure-preserving.
piece_tangent and (IMC)(a): M has approximate tangent space range DG(u) at G(u) for a.e. u ∈ A.
R.orients and uniqueness of approximate tangent spaces: ξ(G u) is a unit orientation of range DG(u).
Measurable sign: s₀ := 1 on {J·ξ∘G = ev}, −1 elsewhere, replaced by a measurable ±1-valued version.
